name: bumdes-banyubening-platform
description: Enterprise-Grade BUMDes Banyubening Platform (Admin Dashboard, Public Website, Program Kerja, WhatsApp Integrated Systems, Reporting, Realtime & DevOps)

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "backend,public,admin" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:public" "npm run start:admin"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "backend,public,admin" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:public" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.setup:env: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','.env'); fs.copyFileSync('.env.example','backend/.env'); console.log('✅ File .env dan backend/.env berhasil dibuat!')"
